clue.text: Part of line where people unusually halt for cheese

explanation.definitionFit: Emmenthal is a Swiss cheese with large holes.

clue.text: Weight spoken about one for barber

clue.text: Bury supplication for questioning

clue.text: Region I can belong to

explanation.definitionFit: Ionic is the adjective for Ionia, an ancient Greek region of Asia Minor.

clue.text: Possibly one record exists before East has to use new words

clue.text: Hour with one roll behind in backing extreme sceptic

clue.text: Creature embraced by amateurs as survivors

clue.text: Waste intelligence on a female

clue.text: Elevation for universal parking rise
